name: Boler Carrier Invoice
description: Monthly carrier invoice (Cigna · Delta · VSP · Fidelity · Hartford) — lives, premium, plan tier, employee/employer split.

documentSchema.description: Monthly carrier statement covering medical, dental, vision, 401k, life, or disability premium for The Boler Company.
documentSchema.extractionInstructions: Extract carrier identity, period covered, every covered life with plan tier + premium, and the totals. Reconcile against the HRIS roster downstream. Distinguish employer-portion vs employee-portion when the statement separates them.

carrier_name.description: Cigna / Delta Dental / VSP / Fidelity / Hartford / Cigna STD-LTD

plan_tiers.description: List of plan tiers + per-tier counts (Premium, Standard, HDHP, Basic)

covered_lives.description: Roster — { employee_id, legal_name, plan_tier, monthly_premium, division_hint }

tax_id_payer.description: Tax ID of the payer (legal entity issuing the check)

drift_vs_plan_doc.description: Variance between billed rate and plan-doc rate (basis points). Filled by reconciliation, not extraction.
